lines.zh: 游动着身躯，发出轻微的哗哗声。
lines.en: Swimming, making soft splashing sounds.

lines.zh: 身体摆动，激起水面涟漪。
lines.en: Body swaying, creating ripples on the water.

lines.zh: 穿梭于水草间，轻盈地游动。
lines.en: Swimming gracefully among the aquatic plants.
Tailing swaying, chasing fish.
Slowly swimming, searching for food.
Spotting prey, persistently pursuing.

lines.zh: 在水中自由游动，优雅而闲适。
lines.en: Swimming freely in the water, gracefully and leisurely.
Gently touching the water plants with its mouth.
Drifting leisurely by.

lines.zh: 在水中游动，发出低沉的咕噜声。
lines.en: Making low gurgling sounds while swimming in water.
One sweep of its tail parts the current.
It cruises slowly along the riverbed.
Its long snout nudges up the river sand.
Its dorsal fin draws a ripple on the surface.
It works its way upstream.
It turns sideways through a gap in the stones.
It darts suddenly after small fish.
Its tail kicks up a ring of silt.
Drifting leisurely, enjoying the tranquility.
Slowly flipping in the water.

lines.zh: 静静地游来游去，寻找机会。
lines.en: Swimming quietly, looking for opportunities.

lines.zh: 在水中打圈，似乎在思考。
lines.en: Circling in the water, seemingly thinking.

lines.zh: 慢慢地在水中漂浮，等待时机。
lines.en: Floating slowly in the water, waiting for the right moment.

lines.zh: 静静地游动，偶尔吐出气泡。
lines.en: Gently swimming, occasionally releasing bubbles.

lines.zh: 悠闲地在水中游动，享受宁静。
lines.en: Relaxing in the water, enjoying the peace.

lines.zh: 静静地漂浮，等待食物的到来。
lines.en: Floating quietly, waiting for food.

lines.zh: 在水中悠然自得地游动。
lines.en: Drifting leisurely in the water.
It holds still over a stone.
It nuzzles the waterweed.
Its gill covers open and close.
It hangs in the shade of a bridge pier.
It rolls slowly onto its other side.

lines.zh: 朝向玩家，露出好奇的目光。
lines.en: Looking at the player, showing curious eyes.
Spotting the player, swimming over to check.

lines.zh: 靠近玩家，观察玩家的动作。
lines.en: Approaching the player, observing their movements.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，显得有些警惕。
lines.en: Staring at the player, seeming wary.

lines.zh: 游近玩家，注意玩家的举动。
lines.en: Approaching the player, watching their actions.

lines.zh: 观察玩家，似乎在寻找机会。
lines.en: Observing the player, seeming to look for an opportunity.
Approaching the player, curiously observing.
Noticing the player, swimming closer.

lines.zh: 游近玩家，准备攻击或逃跑。
lines.en: Approaching the player, ready to attack or escape.

lines.zh: 我停在你的影子里，尾巴不动。
lines.en: I hold still in your shadow without moving my tail.
My body's damaged, mend me!

lines.zh: 我这一身硬鳞，被撬开了一道。
lines.en: A gap has been pried in these hard scutes.
Injured, needs healing.
That wound hurts!
A plate of my hard scales has been torn away.
Hit hard, hurts!
Severe wound!
Injured, very painful.

lines.zh: 鲟鱼的硬鳞，也挡不住这一下。
lines.en: Even sturgeon scutes cannot stop that.
Injured, need help!

lines.zh: 别诱惑我，我的鳞片很锋利！
lines.en: Don't tempt me! My scales are sharp!
Want to try my fins?

lines.zh: 鱼肉的香味吸引你了吗？
lines.en: The smell of fish meat is tempting you, isn't it?

lines.zh: 我这里有美味的鱼子酱！
lines.en: I have some delicious caviar!
Be careful, I'll smash you with my tail!
My big mouth can suck you in!
Find a mate in the fish swarm!

lines.zh: 我可不是好惹的，尝尝我的力量吧！
lines.en: Don't mess with me, feel my power!
The meat can be cooked!
Don't come close, I'll bite you!
Watch out, I might collide with you!

lines.zh: 鱼儿们在碰撞中寻找食物！
lines.en: The fish collide in search of food!

lines.zh: 我的身体太沉重，会撞倒你！
lines.en: My body is too heavy, I'll knock you over!
Finding new territory through collisions!
Be careful, I might knock you out!

lines.zh: 鱼群中的碰撞是生存方式！
lines.en: Collisions are a way of life in the fish swarm!

lines.zh: 小心，我可能会撞毁你的结构！
lines.en: Be careful, I might destroy your structure!
Collisions in the fish swarm are dangerous!

lines.zh: 我可能会撞碎你的防御！
lines.en: I might break through your defenses!
Finding new paths through collisions!
Come, find a mate!
The fish are seeking mates!
Find a mate to reproduce together!
I'm the male fish, finding a female!
Female, let's reproduce together!
The male needs to find a female!

lines.zh: 鱼子酱的卵，还在我腹里。
lines.en: The roe is still in my belly.

lines.zh: 我腹里的鱼卵已经沉甸甸。
lines.en: The roe in my belly already feels heavy.
The male and female pair up to reproduce!
Come, let's reproduce offspring!
Look at this big sturgeon!
Try this sturgeon肉！

lines.zh: 我把落水的东西拱到石缝里。
lines.en: I nudge what fell in the water under a rock.
Caviar is delicious！
Cook the fish！
This sturgeon is heavy！
Such fresh fish meat！
This sturgeon is special！
This sturgeon is treasure！
This sturgeon is valuable！
My target！

lines.zh: 河床的卵石一翻，就是我了。
lines.en: One turn of riverbed gravel, and that is me.
Target captured！
Fishes are here！
The roe inside me is worth a fortune.
Fish passing by！
Fishes coming！
Bonemeal drifts down beneath me.
Track the fishes！
Target fish！

lines.zh: 我的长吻贴着河底扫过去。
lines.en: My long snout sweeps along the riverbed.
Watch it！
Don't let it go！
Fishes are fast！
Fishes are wary！
Fishes are avoiding！
Fishes are swimming！
Fishes are feeding！
Fishes are resting！
It is about to swallow it whole.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的咕噜声，用尖锐的颚咬住敌人。
lines.en: Growsl and uses its sharp jaws to bite enemies.

lines.zh: 挥动尾巴，向附近的目标发起攻击。
lines.en: Swishes its tail to attack nearby targets.

lines.zh: 张开大嘴，发出嘶嘶声，准备吞噬猎物。
lines.en: Opens its large mouth with hisses, ready to devour prey.

lines.zh: 用强壮的尾巴击打对手，造成伤害。
lines.en: Pounds opponents with its powerful tail.

lines.zh: 迅速游动，向敌人发起迅猛攻击。
lines.en: Rushes forward to attack enemies.

lines.zh: 释放一股电流，电击附近的敌人。
lines.en: Releases an electric shock to stun nearby enemies.

lines.zh: 用利齿咬住猎物，拖入水中。
lines.en: Grasps prey with its sharp teeth, dragging them underwater.

lines.zh: 游动到目标附近，突然发起攻击。
lines.en: Swims up to targets and attacks suddenly.

lines.zh: 用尾鳍拍击水面，攻击对手。
lines.en: Whips its tail against the water to attack.

lines.zh: 用嘴巴夹住猎物，用力拖拽。
lines.en: Clamps its mouth around prey and drags it away.

lines.zh: 在水中缓缓孵化，从蛋中破壳而出。
lines.en: Hatches slowly in water, breaking out of its egg.

lines.zh: 从水底慢慢爬出，孵化成幼体。
lines.en: Emerges from the bottom of the water, hatching into a larva.

lines.zh: 在水下寻找安全的地方孵化。
lines.en: Hatches in a safe spot underwater.

lines.zh: 在沉船残骸中孵化，寻找庇护。
lines.en: Hatches in the wreckage of a sunken ship for shelter.

lines.zh: 在珊瑚礁旁孵化，开始新生活。
lines.en: Hatches near coral reefs, starting a new life.

lines.zh: 在水藻丛中孵化，融入环境。
lines.en: Hatches among water algae, blending in with the environment.

lines.zh: 在废弃的水下基地孵化，利用旧设施。
lines.en: Hatches in an abandoned underwater base, using old infrastructure.

lines.zh: 在黑暗的水洞中孵化，避免天敌。
lines.en: Hatches in dark water caves to avoid predators.

lines.zh: 在河流入海口孵化，寻找丰富食物源。
lines.en: Hatches at river mouths to find abundant food sources.

lines.zh: 在海底火山附近孵化，获取热能。
lines.en: Hatches near underwater volcanoes for heat.
A splash rises in the shallows.
One more long shadow on the riverbed.

lines.zh: 身体破了，快修一修，被火烧的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: My body's damaged, mend me! — and the fire makes it worse.
Ouch, fell into water!
Save me, I'm sinking!
Explosion hurt, heal!
Hit by projectile!
Hit by magic, hurts!
Starving, need food!

lines.zh: 电流顺着我的长须窜下去。
lines.en: The current runs down my long barbels.

lines.zh: 没有水，我的鳃一张一合。
lines.en: There is no water here, and my gills open and close.
